* **Built against core 0.0.34**: requires `bankstatementparser >=
  0.0.34`, the newest core release; the lockfile moves core and the
  dev-only `ruff` to 0.17.6.
* **Suite check covers every member**: the scheduled Suite Consistency
  job now compares all fourteen packages on PyPI and the
  bankstatementparser.com release.
* **In lockstep with the suite's 0.0.35 release**: all fourteen packages and bankstatementparser.com ship 0.0.35 together, eight of the packages on PyPI for the first time.
